primary_metric: Mean average precision over clean, 10%, 30%, and 50% MCAR test conditions; average within seed then across seeds
prior_art_status: Core components and the missingness-shift problem have close prior art: median imputation plus mask features (2022 benchmark) and MI-based robustness conditions for unseen missingness shifts (MIRRAMS, 2025). Novelty not established.
limitations: HistGradientBoosting cannot validly warm-start across changing datasets; implementation uses cumulative phase strata in a single final fit, not sequential optimization curriculum.
Synthetic MCAR feature deletion only; no MAR/MNAR, naturally occurring data, or unknown shift patterns.
Only three seeds and one generated dataset family; exploratory pilot, not a significance claim.
MI weighting did not outperform uniform mask weights, so that mechanism is unsupported in this study.
Preregistration file was recorded after the final evaluation process completed, though before held-out metrics were inspected; this is exploratory rather than strict preregistration.
